mapper.select: SELECT id,source_name,source_type,original_url,copyright_status,review_status,copyright_note,reviewed_by,review_comment,reviewed_at,created_at,updated_at,enabled FROM exam_question_source ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT q.id,q.group_id,q.source_id,q.question_type,q.stem,q.difficulty,q.knowledge_points,q.review_status,q.enabled, s.source_name,g.title AS group_title FROM exam_question q LEFT JOIN exam_question_source s ON s.id=q.source_id LEFT JOIN exam_question_group g ON g.id=q.group_id ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id,group_id,question_type,stem,options,correct_answer,explanation,reference_answer,sample_answer,scoring_rubric, source_id,group_sort_order,difficulty,knowledge_points,content_fingerprint,review_status,enabled,created_at,updated_at FROM exam_question WHERE group_id=#{groupId} ORDER BY group_sort_order,id
SELECT id,blueprint_code,blueprint_name,version,status,duration_minutes,total_score FROM exam_blueprint ORDER BY id
mapper.sql: s.review_status='APPROVED' AND s.enabled=1 AND s.copyright_status IN ('ORIGINAL','AUTHORIZED','PUBLIC_OFFICIAL')

SELECT g.id,g.group_type,COUNT(q.id) AS item_count FROM exam_question_group g JOIN exam_question_source s ON s.id=g.source_id JOIN exam_question q ON q.group_id=g.id WHERE g.review_status='APPROVED' AND g.enabled=1 AND GROUP BY g.id,g.group_type,g.source_id HAVING SUM(q.review_status!='APPROVED' OR q.enabled!=1 OR q.source_id!=g.source_id OR (g.group_type='DIALOGUE' AND q.question_type!='DIALOGUE_BLANK') OR (g.group_type='READING' AND q.question_type!='READING'))=0
mapper.select: SELECT eligible.item_count AS member_count,COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM () eligible WHERE eligible.group_type='DIALOGUE' GROUP BY eligible.item_count ORDER BY eligible.item_count

SELECT b.question_type,b.section_order,b.group_count,b.answer_item_count, COALESCE(gr.available_groups,0) AS available_groups, CASE WHEN b.group_count>0 THEN COALESCE(gr.available_items,0) ELSE COALESCE(qc.available_items,0) END AS available_items FROM exam_blueprint_section b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT eligible.group_type,COUNT(*) AS available_groups,SUM(eligible.item_count) AS available_items FROM () eligible WHERE (eligible.group_type='READING' AND eligible.item_count=5) OR (eligible.group_type='DIALOGUE' AND eligible.item_count BETWEEN 1 AND 8) GROUP BY eligible.group_type ) gr ON gr.group_type=b.question_type LEFT JOIN ( SELECT q.question_type,COUNT(*) AS available_items FROM exam_question q JOIN exam_question_source s ON s.id=q.source_id WHERE q.group_id IS NULL AND q.review_status='APPROVED' AND q.enabled=1 AND GROUP BY q.question_type ) qc ON qc.question_type=b.question_type WHERE b.blueprint_id=#{blueprintId} ORDER BY b.section_order
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_question_source SET enabled=#{enabled} WHERE id=#{id} AND #{enabled} IN (0,1)
UPDATE exam_blueprint SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id} AND #{status} IN ('ENABLED','DISABLED')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_paper_group_snapshot WHERE original_group_id=#{groupId}
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_question_group SET group_type=#{groupType},title=#{title},instruction=#{instruction},content=#{content}, shared_options=#{sharedOptions},source_id=#{sourceId},difficulty=#{difficulty},knowledge_points=#{knowledgePoints}, content_fingerprint=#{contentFingerprint} WHERE id=#{id} AND review_status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING','REJECTED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exam_paper_group_snapshot WHERE original_group_id=#{id})

UPDATE exam_question SET question_type=#{questionType},stem=#{stem},options=#{options},correct_answer=#{correctAnswer}, explanation=#{explanation},reference_answer=#{referenceAnswer},sample_answer=#{sampleAnswer},scoring_rubric=#{scoringRubric}, source_id=#{sourceId},difficulty=#{difficulty},knowledge_points=#{knowledgePoints},content_fingerprint=#{contentFingerprint} WHERE id=#{id} AND review_status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING','REJECTED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exam_paper_item_snapshot WHERE original_question_id=#{id})
